description: Real de novo model output. Backbone poses and limited proxies only; no official score or wet-lab KD.

sequence.charged_fraction.meaning: D/E/K/R fraction; extreme charge may explain a score artifact

sequence.hydrophobic_fraction.meaning: A/F/I/L/M/V/W/Y fraction; not all exposed hydrophobicity

sequence.entropy.meaning: single-residue Shannon entropy; not a novelty test

sequence.instability_index.meaning: Guruprasad sequence heuristic; not measured stability

sequence.hydrophobic8_max.meaning: maximum hydrophobic fraction in eight-residue window; aggregation-risk proxy

geometry.target_CA_rmsd.meaning: generated target CA versus reference A88-251 after alignment

geometry.binder_Rg.meaning: binder CA radius of gyration; rod/compactness diagnostic, not an affinity score

geometry.binder_nonlocal_CA_pairs8.meaning: binder CA pairs within 8 A separated by at least 8 sequence positions

geometry.CA_contact_pairs8.meaning: full observed trimer / binder CA pairs within 8 A

geometry.epitope_residues5.meaning: target residues with any heavy atom within 5 A of binder BACKBONE

geometry.other_chain_min_BB_distance.meaning: binder backbone to unconditioned trimer B/C heavy atoms

geometry.other_chain_BB_clash_pairs2.meaning: binder backbone / trimer B/C atom pairs below 2 A

geometry.glycan_ND2_min_BB_distance.meaning: minimum binder backbone distance to six N133/N229 ND2 anchors; not a glycan simulation

geometry.missing_tail_anchor_distance.meaning: binder backbone distance to resolved A88 N; proximity flag only

rfd.final_binder_plddt.meaning: last denoising-step mean binder confidence; shared by all sequences on one backbone, NOT refold confidence

mpnn.score.meaning: mean designed-residue negative log probability, T=0.1, C omitted

official.ipsae.meaning: official admission score; no substitute imputed

boltz.iptm.meaning: maximum directional binder-target pair ipTM; excludes target-target pairs; NOT official ESMFold2 screening

boltz.binder_plddt.meaning: mean designed-chain token pLDDT; NOT official ESMFold2 screening

boltz.ipsae_10.meaning: pinned ipSAE, PAE/distance cutoffs 10 A; maximum over binder-target directional pairs only; NOT official ESMFold2 screening

boltz.ipsae_15.meaning: pinned ipSAE, PAE/distance cutoffs 15 A; maximum over binder-target directional pairs only; NOT official ESMFold2 screening

boltz.binder_CA_rmsd.meaning: binder CA RMSD to design after experimental target beta-core alignment (pose agreement); NOT official ESMFold2 screening

boltz.binder_fold_CA_rmsd.meaning: binder-only aligned CA RMSD to design (fold agreement); NOT official ESMFold2 screening

boltz.target_CA_rmsd.meaning: predicted target A88-251 versus 2RE9 aligned CA RMSD; NOT official ESMFold2 screening

boltz.other_chain_clash_pairs2.meaning: all-atom predicted binder vs observed native trimer B/C atom pairs <2 A; NOT official ESMFold2 screening

boltz.glycan_ND2_min_distance.meaning: all-atom predicted binder vs six native N133/N229 ND2 anchors; NOT official ESMFold2 screening
